title: 实验 2-6 · 同相放大器：电位器给输入，测出电压增益
summary: LM358 + RF 22kΩ + RG 10kΩ 同相放大：用电位器给直流输入，逐点测输入和输出，算出增益，再把输入调大看输出饱和。
description:
**目标**：搭一个同相放大器，用直流电压逐点测它的输入—输出关系，验证 Uo = (1 + RF/RG) × Ui，并看看输出饱和。

**电路**（单电源 9 V）：
- LM358：8 脚 V+ 接 +9V，4 脚 V− 接 GND；
- 输入：电位器 RV1（10kΩ）**1 脚接 GND、3 脚接 +9V**，滑动端接 IN+。这样 Ui ≈ 9 V × 旋钮位置（10% ≈ 0.9 V）。运放输入不取电流，所以电位器不受影响；
- 反馈：RF（22kΩ）从 OUT 接到 IN−，RG（10kΩ）从 IN− 接到 GND。

LM358 横跨凹槽，每只脚独占一列：凹槽上方一排从左到右是 1 脚 OUT A、2 脚 IN− A、3 脚 IN+ A、4 脚 V−（单电源时接 GND）；下方一排从左到右是 8 脚 V+、7 脚 OUT B、6 脚 IN− B、5 脚 IN+ B。芯片里有两个运放，用 A、B 哪一个都可以。

**先预测**：用虚短（U− = U+ = Ui）和虚断（RG 上的电流全部流过 RF）推出增益，再算旋钮在 10%、20%、50% 时的 Uo。别忘了 LM358 的输出最高只到 V+ − 1.5 V：哪一个位置会超出？

**测量**：把旋钮转到 10%、20%、50%，每次测 IN+、IN− 和 OUT 对 GND 的电压，再测 RG、RF 的电流。电路检查通过后，把读数填进下面的「测量」（以你自己的面包板为准）；答完后会显示计算对比。

**想一想**：这个放大器的线性输入范围是多少？多转几个位置，把 Uo–Ui 画成一条线：斜率是多少，在哪里变平？

**真实电路里**：输出到不了 V+（约 V+ − 1.5 V）这一点仿真里也有。真实 LM358 的输入共模范围也只到约 V+ − 1.5 V = 7.5 V：旋钮转到约 83%（7.5 / 9）以上时 IN+ 超过这个值，真实芯片的行为就不可靠了（仿真不模拟输入端的这个限制）。

en.title: Experiment 2-6 · Non-inverting amplifier: a pot for the input, measure the gain
en.summary: An LM358 non-inverting amplifier with RF 22kΩ and RG 10kΩ: feed DC from a pot, measure input and output point by point, work out the gain, then turn the input up and watch the output saturate.
en.description:
**Goal**: build a non-inverting amplifier, measure its input–output relation point by point with DC voltages, check Uo = (1 + RF/RG) × Ui, and see the output saturate.

**Circuit** (single 9 V supply):
- LM358: pin 8 V+ to +9V, pin 4 V− to GND;
- input: pot RV1 (10kΩ) with **pin 1 to GND and pin 3 to +9V**, wiper to IN+. Then Ui ≈ 9 V × knob position (10% ≈ 0.9 V). The op-amp input draws no current, so it doesn't disturb the pot;
- feedback: RF (22kΩ) from OUT to IN−, RG (10kΩ) from IN− to GND.

The LM358 straddles the gap, each pin on its own column: the row above the gap is, left to right, pin 1 OUT A, pin 2 IN− A, pin 3 IN+ A, pin 4 V− (GND on a single supply); the row below is, left to right, pin 8 V+, pin 7 OUT B, pin 6 IN− B, pin 5 IN+ B. The chip holds two op-amps; either A or B is fine.

**Predict first**: derive the gain from the virtual short (U− = U+ = Ui) and the virtual open (the current in RG all flows through RF), then work out Uo with the knob at 10%, 20% and 50%. Remember the LM358 output only reaches V+ − 1.5 V: which setting goes past it?

**Measure**: set the knob to 10%, 20% and 50%; each time measure IN+, IN− and OUT to GND, and the currents in RG and RF. Once the circuit check passes, type your readings into the Measurements below (whatever your own board shows); the worked comparison appears after you answer.

**Think about it**: what is the linear input range of this amplifier? Try more knob positions and plot Uo against Ui: what is the slope, and where does the line go flat?

**In a real circuit**: the output not reaching V+ (about V+ − 1.5 V) is in the simulator too. A real LM358's common-mode input range also only reaches about V+ − 1.5 V = 7.5 V: above about 83% on the knob (7.5 / 9) IN+ goes past it and a real chip no longer behaves reliably (the simulator does not model this input limit).

measurements.ask: Knob at 10%: IN+ to GND, Ui
Knob at 10%: OUT to GND, Uo
From your two readings, the voltage gain Uo / Ui
measurements.explain: Virtual short U− = Ui; virtual open, so RG's current all flows through RF: Uo = Ui + RF × Ui / RG = (1 + 22/10) Ui = 3.2 Ui.
3.2 × 4.5 = 14.4 V in theory, but the LM358 output tops out at V+ − 1.5 V ≈ 7.5 V: saturated (clipped).

measurements.ask: Knob at 50%: IN− to GND (compare it with IN+)
measurements.explain: IN− = 7.5 × 10 / 32 ≈ 2.34 V, no longer equal to IN+ = 4.5 V: when saturated the feedback cannot regulate, so the virtual short fails.

hints: Power the op-amp first: pin 8 to +9V, pin 4 to GND.
Pot direction: pin 1 to GND, pin 3 to +9V, the middle wiper to IN+ (pin 3 of the chip). Wired the other way, the knob works backwards.
RF goes between OUT and IN− (not IN+); RG from IN− to GND.
tests: 10%: OUT is IN+ times the gain, IN− follows IN+ (virtual short)
20%: OUT still linear; RG's current all flows through RF

tests.name: 10%：OUT 按增益放大 IN+，IN− 跟着 IN+（虚短）
20%：OUT 仍在线性区；RG 的电流全部流过 RF

measurements.ask: 旋钮 10%：IN+ 对 GND 的电压 Ui
旋钮 10%：OUT 对 GND 的电压 Uo
用你的两个读数算电压增益 Uo / Ui
measurements.explain: 虚短 U− = Ui，虚断让 RG 的电流全部流过 RF：Uo = Ui + RF × Ui / RG = (1 + 22/10) Ui = 3.2 Ui。

measurements.ask: 旋钮 50%：OUT 对 GND 的电压
旋钮 50%：IN− 对 GND 的电压（和 IN+ 比一比）
measurements.explain: IN− = 7.5 × 10 / 32 ≈ 2.34 V，不再等于 IN+ 的 4.5 V：饱和时没有负反馈调节，虚短不成立。

hints: 先给运放供电：8 脚 +9V，4 脚 GND。
电位器方向：1 脚接 GND，3 脚接 +9V，中间滑动端接 IN+（3 脚）。反了的话旋钮方向也反了。
RF 接在 OUT 和 IN− 之间（不是 IN+），RG 从 IN− 接到 GND。
